behavioralConstraints: task canonicalBranch is authoritative, non-empty, and never whitespace-normalized
leading or trailing whitespace in canonicalBranch is rejected with INVALID_TASK_BRANCH
main is the default bootstrap integration target
task and base branch existence are checked only as local refs/heads entries
tags and other non-head refs cannot satisfy canonical branch or base branch identity
missing canonical branches are created from the local main branch only when the repository is currently on main
existing canonical branches are reused without force-moving
unrelated active branches are rejected rather than silently switched
Git shell commands are confined to LocalGitBranchOperations
invariants: task-domain callers do not need Git process details
branch identity cannot silently differ from task metadata
branch identity refers to local branch heads rather than ambiguous short refs
branch creation never force-moves an existing branch
an existing canonical branch must retain local main as an ancestor
examples: BOOT-011 on main creates bootstrap/boot-011-branch-lifecycle from refs/heads/main and checks it out
re-running ensure on the canonical branch returns created=false
requesting bootstrap/wrong for BOOT-011 fails with WRONG_BRANCH
edgeCases: canonicalBranch with leading or trailing whitespace fails with INVALID_TASK_BRANCH
same-named tag without a local canonical branch does not count as branch existence
same-named main tag without refs/heads/main fails with BASE_REF_NOT_FOUND
missing local main fails with BASE_REF_NOT_FOUND
non-main requested base fails with BASE_REF_MISMATCH
detached or unrelated branch fails with WRONG_BRANCH
canonical branch not descended from local main fails with BRANCH_DIVERGED

expectations: receive the exact canonical task branch from task metadata without normalization
ensure a missing canonical local branch from local main safely
never confuse tags or other refs for task/base branch heads
receive deterministic actionable rejection for wrong or invalid branch state
acceptedRanges: BranchEnsureResult with created true or false
requiredReachableRanges: same-named tag ignored for local branch existence
